column3: NASB adds “were.”
NASB renders “the age” as “the course,” “ruler” as “prince,” and “authority” as “power.”
NASB follows the critical text; “desires” is rendered “lusts,” “doing” is “indulging,” and “thoughts” is “mind.”

NASB renders “have become near” as “have been brought near.”

NASB renders “having slain the hostility” as “having put to death the enmity.”
